title: Eating Out
text:
A menu is a list of food and drinks in a restaurant. The menu has the names of the dishes and their prices. Read the menu before you order. Ask the waiter if you have questions.

Today I want soup and rice. My friend wants fish and a juice. The waiter writes our order and brings the food in ten minutes. We pay at the end of the meal.

options: A list of food and drinks

questions.text: What does the writer want to eat?
Why should you read the menu before you order?
options: To know what food is available and choose
To find the name of the waiter
To learn the history of the restaurant

questions.text: When does the writer probably pay for the meal?
options: Before the waiter brings the menu
At the end of the meal

vocabulary.definition: a list of the food and drinks a restaurant serves
a person who serves food and drinks in a restaurant
the food or drinks you ask for in a restaurant

paragraph_translations: Um cardápio é uma lista de comidas e bebidas em um restaurante. O cardápio tem os nomes dos pratos e os preços. Leia o cardápio antes de pedir. Pergunte ao garçom se você tiver dúvidas.
Hoje eu quero sopa e arroz. Meu amigo quer peixe e um suco. O garçom anota nosso pedido e traz a comida em dez minutos. Nós pagamos no final da refeição.
